title: Vendor and order management Delete lets the user delete vendors and purchase orders and reverse vendor transactions
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Parts Department ON and Vendor and order management View, Create & Edit and Delete.
custom_steps:
1. Log in and delete a vendor and a purchase order.
  2. Reverse a vendor transaction from the vendor's Unpaid Invoices / Payments tab.
custom_expected:
The vendor and the purchase order are deleted.

The vendor transaction is reversed.

Note: the reverse action lives inside the vendor Payments tab, which also needs View and Manage AP/AR Data on to reach it.
evidence: Needs live UI; AP/AR dependency on the vendor Payments tab is build-observed.
